summary: V2X filed an 8-K reporting a secondary public offering of 2,004,569 common shares by the selling shareholder, Vertex Aerospace Holdco LLC, via an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley as sole underwriter. The offering closed on May 11, 2026; V2X received no proceeds. Post-offering, the selling shareholder retains no direct shares, but an affiliate holds 375,420 shares (~1.2%). This is a routine public-market secondary sale, not a special situation.
